subject: english
question:
**Sentences of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph.**

A. On my way to school, I met my uncle who had returned from England.

B. Then I invited him to my place.

C. He was very pleased to see me and asked about my parents.

D. On he asking me about my parents, I told him my father recalls him frequently.
solution:
Here the correct answer is **ACDB**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Sentence A** is the introductory statement as it opens up the paragraph.
 
• **Sentence C **is the next statement as after meeting the narrator, his uncle asked him about his parents.
 
• **Sentence D** will be the next statement as it mentions what the narrator said when he was asked about his parents.
 
• **Sentence B** will be the last sentence as it mentions what the narrator did after telling his uncle about his parents.
 
• Thus, the correct answer is **Option 3.**

**Correct Sequence:**__ ***A.** On my way to school, I met my uncle who had returned from England.** C. **He was very pleased to see me and asked about my parents. **D.** On he asking me about my parents, I told him my father recalls him frequently. **B. **Then I invited him to my place.*
